trust_decision.summary: Whether the server certificate's identity matches the configured LDAP host during the TLS handshake (LDAPS and StartTLS). This is decided in the MINA SslFilter that LdapNetworkConnection.addSslFilter builds. At the pinned commit no endpoint identification algorithm is set, so only the certificate chain is checked.

landing_point.why: The only place in the tree that builds a TLS layer (SSLContext plus SslFilter). Grepping for SslFilter or SSLContext leads straight to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: LdapNetworkConnection.connect() with useSsl (LDAPS, via createConnector at :560-562), and LdapNetworkConnection.startTls() (explicit, or automatic from connect() when useTls is set, :1030-1032 and :5045)
LdapConnectionConfig new getter and setter for sslEndpointIdentificationAlgorithm (default "LDAPS"; null opts out)
fix_sites.module_kind: config bean (adds an opt-out knob, not a second check site)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second TLS implementation: SslFilter, SSLContext and SSLEngine are used only in ldap/client/api LdapNetworkConnection.java (:183, :5091, :5095). ldap/net/mina, dsml/engine and the pool factories all go through LdapNetworkConnection (DefaultLdapConnectionFactory.java:140-144, Dsmlv2Engine.java:151).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is little to dismiss. LDAPS and StartTLS share one private addSslFilter, so one line covers both. The only argument a solver could make is that custom trust managers (LdapClientTrustStoreManager) own validation. But LdapClientTrustStoreManager implements plain X509TrustManager (LdapClientTrustStoreManager.java:54), which JSSE wraps with the hostname check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: NoVerificationTrustManager (an X509ExtendedTrustManager with no-op checks) must still let mismatched hosts connect, and the fix's own test asserts this. A hand-rolled post-handshake hostname check, or wrapping the configured trust managers, would break this opt-out and the null-algorithm opt-out.

O6_input_shapes: LDAPS connection (useSsl, filter added to the connector before connect)
StartTLS on an existing session (filter added to the live ioSession)
connection built from host/port/TrustManager... constructor vs from LdapConnectionConfig (fix.diff:277, fix.diff:354)

O7_producer.where: ldap/client/api/src/main/java/org/apache/directory/ldap/client/api/LdapConnectionConfig.java:122 (new field added after this line per fix.diff:36-37); host comes from config.getLdapHost() at LdapNetworkConnection.java:718

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A DSML engine option that opens an LDAPS or StartTLS connection with its own SSLContext/SslFilter or SSLSocket, without endpoint identification
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The DSML engine is a separate package that builds its own connection. A maintainer adding TLS support there could plausibly wire MINA or JSSE directly. It sits at a distance from the landing point (another Maven module).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Split addSslFilter into separate LDAPS and StartTLS builders, or add a reconnect/rebind path that rebuilds the SslFilter, so only one of them gets the algorithm
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The two branches already diverge inside addSslFilter, so splitting them is a plausible refactor. But it is a WHERE-type sibling of one concept, so it counts as an extra only.

O9_family: improper certificate validation: missing TLS hostname verification (CWE-297)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven, JDK (version not checked), MINA core 2.2.5 (pom.xml:81)
O10_build.project_tests: None at the pinned commit for TLS hostname checks in ldap/client/api (no *Ssl* test). The fix adds LdapNetworkConnectionSslTest, which uses an in-memory BouncyCastle cert and a loopback SSLServerSocket, so it runs offline.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Hard-code sslFilter.setEndpointIdentificationAlgorithm("LDAPS") (or "HTTPS") in addSslFilter. This is effectively the published fix, so the obvious fix is also the full fix.

out_of_scope_notes: LdapClientTrustStoreManager's javadoc says it 'allows self-signed certificates to pass' (LdapClientTrustStoreManager.java:50). This is chain trust, not hostname checking; not pursued.
unverified: That MINA 2.2.5 SslFilter creates its SSLEngine with the peer host string from the session remote address (needed for the hostname check to compare against config.getLdapHost()). The jar was not inspected.
Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell).

The O12 flag single_site is applied because the only functional change is one line in addSslFilter, plus a config getter/setter. O1 is 2 because LDAPS and StartTLS reach it, but both go through the same function.
Whether the change is present in the latest release: no latest tree was provided.
